assumptions.text: Grouped right_side_view:F1 and thread_detail:F1 as the same external thread based on matching thread_spec "3/4"-32UN-2A" and the THREAD DETAIL context (Signal 5/detail-view logic).

Selected thread_detail:F1 as canonical for the external thread because it provides the detailed major/pitch/minor diameters with tolerances; thread length will be taken from right_side_view:F1 via union.
Declared the central bore (front_view:F1) coaxial with the external thread group given common axis evidence across views; no explicit GD&T provided.
Treated the 4X radial slots (front_view:F2) as an aggregate pattern not individually modeled elsewhere; left as a single feature with count=4 and no separate identity groups.
Set the central bore Ø15.2 to run THRU across the full part thickness (nominal 3.5 mm).
Set the 4X R1 radial slots to break out on one face only.
The 4X R1 slots are assumed to be through-features extending through the full axial length of the component bore, as no partial depth is specified.
